column3: Close to the Hebrew; “from the light” is rendered “from morning.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to our lord(s)” is capitalized as God, “our LORD,” and מָעֻזְּכֶם (“refuge, stronghold”) is rendered “strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; עֲלֵי־ (“leaves, foliage”) is rendered “branches.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they dwelt in the booths” is rendered “sat under the booths.”
